n_data.text: Sample data for layout only. Dark theme uses the app's dash-* tokens (Barlow Condensed over Archivo). Click a position chip or a player name to try the filter and the expand panel.

n_header.text: Summary strip: when your next claim resolves (earliest clear among your pending claims), FAAB left after pending bids, Waiver priority, and whether a drop is required.

n_phone.text: Phone: cards instead of a 7-column table, On waivers / My claims tabs, a full-height claim sheet with a swap preview, radio drops and $1 / Max bid shortcuts, and a neutral warning on both claims that share a drop.

n_rows.text: The list is the Players page list locked to On waivers: search, position, bye week and Upgrade sort all run on the server. Expand shows the swap, rest of season, clear time and News; the Decision card holds the rest. Ownership shows once #1308 lands.
